concept.hr: Asinkrone replike kasne; preuzimanje gubi rep; čitanje vlastitih upisa
concept.en: Async replicas lag; failover loses the tail; reading your own writes

summary.hr: Klijent piše na primarni, replike iste zapise primjenjuju kasnije. Čitaj s replike, čekaj svoj zapis ili sruši primarni i vidi koji se potvrđeni upisi gube.
summary.en: A client writes to the primary; replicas apply the same records later. Read from a replica, wait for your record, or fail the primary and see what is lost.
